note: Hatchery lake north of Hunnewell off Route Z. The primitive camping area is a pair of gravel lanes among trees near the hatchery buildings on the east side of the lake, beside the Mayes Arm boat ramp, with privies close by. Each campsite holds one camping unit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard (no permit rule, no Rule 101); brochure 'Camping is permitted in designated area'; map (08/21/23) one 'Primitive Camping' symbol by the Mayes Arm ramp; GIS 195. Pin is at the Route Z entrance - move 290 m to the camping lanes. Lakeview downgraded to not waterfront (tree line + ~100 m). Phone to add: (573) 248-2530. Dump station not on any MDC source.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard, no 'special use permit only' rule, no Rule 101. Brochure: 'Camping is permitted in designated area ... Campsites are limited to one camping or sleeping unit per site.' Map (08/21/23): 'Primitive Camping' symbol and privies at the improved-road loop by the Mayes Arm ramp. Imagery: two parallel gravel lanes ~150 m long with RVs and trailers parked between them. A 23-ft rig fits. Stays.
PIN (move): stored 39.7134,-91.8601 is the entrance-road junction with Route Z, 290 m NE of the camping area. Move to GIS 195, 39.71191,-91.86285, between the two camping lanes.

WATERFRONT CHANGE: lakeview -> not waterfront. Evidence: 'satellite 39.7119,-91.8629 (Esri, leaf-on): the camping lanes sit ~100-130 m east of the Mayes Arm shore, behind a near-continuous tree row along the west lane and a wooded shoreline; hatchery buildings and the ramp parking lie between the south end and the water; no RV site overlooks the lake. MDC map/brochure make no lake-view claim.' The old value rested on the note's 'lakeside' wording.

DUMP STATION: no MDC source mentions one (area page, brochure, 2023 map legend all silent). Only aggregators do (Campendium POI 'Hunnewell Lake RV Dump Station'; The Dyrt 'dump station with potable water located behind the ranger station'). Stored facilities.dump true (derived) left as is, not written as manual; the note no longer asserts it. The brochure's local office (573) 983-2201 would confirm.
PHONE (add): the area page lists (573) 248-2530 (Northeast regional office, Hannibal); store 573-248-2530. The brochure also gives the Hunnewell area office (573) 983-2201 (6503 Highway Z).
CLUSTERS: one camping point (GIS 195); no split. near.py: no other entry within 3 km.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row (not written per entry).
